tests.goal: Confirm that an admin user can access the admin panel and a non-admin cannot

steps.action: Go to Settings > General > scroll to the bottom.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users will see the Admin Panel button
Non-admin users will NOT see the Admin Panel button

steps.action: Admin users: Navigate to the Admin Panel by clicking the button.
Non-admin users: open the environment's configured Admin Panel URL directly in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: Access is denied (a forbidden message is shown) and the admin panel does not load
